title: Default-off Q8_0 output-writing subset before performance benchmark

bottleneck_component.name: DeepSeek decode CPU up/down fallback plus source/page behavior

prior_evidence.coverage: bounded samples over blk.0-2 ffn_up_exps and ffn_down_exps
prior_evidence.limitation: probe did not write model outputs and therefore did not prove token-level correctness

candidate.name: Q8_0 CUDA overwrite after CPU fallback
candidate.why_not_benchmark_yet: The first output-writing path intentionally keeps CPU fallback and overwrites dst afterward. It is only a token-level correctness gate, not a speed path.
candidate.expected_ram_pressure: small temporary CUDA/host result buffers for cne1<=1; default path has no added allocation
candidate.expected_ttft_impact: none when unset; enabled verifier run is diagnostic only and cannot be promoted

implementation_boundary: Add a new env-gated CUDA function separate from the existing diagnostic probe.
Enable only when GGML_MOE_STREAM_Q80_WRITE_NAME_FILTER is set.
Do not skip CPU fallback in this step.
Compute CUDA MXFP4 x Q8_0 for matching tensor/expert rows, compare against current CPU fallback dst, then overwrite dst with CUDA values.
Restrict default diagnostic use to cne1<=1 via GGML_MOE_STREAM_Q80_WRITE_MAX_CNE1.
Optionally write per-call max_abs/mean_abs report when GGML_MOE_STREAM_Q80_WRITE_REPORT is set.
Do not touch direct hot pool, gate cache, accepted SOTA envs, or default output path.
correctness_gate: Create baseline result.gguf with output-writing disabled.
Run check with output-writing enabled for blk.0.ffn_up_exps.weight.
Pass condition: llama-results exits 0, same_top1 == n_tokens, first_mismatch_pos == -1.
If top1 fails or NMSE fails, revert runtime source and keep only rejected artifact.
promotion_rule: This step cannot be promoted as SOTA. Any later benchmark requires a top1-passing output-writing path that actually skips/hides CPU fallback and then strict cold 16GB France validation.
push_rule: If the top1 gate passes and default behavior remains unchanged, commit and push source plus artifacts to ssd/vendor/deepseek-token-rate-16gb using L-Ark.
